text:
sam: Heads-up: saw a small but sharp token billing spike at 03:20 UTC tied to WebSocket clients. Pattern: client sees a clean close, immediately reconnects, tokens doubled for same conversation id.

lina: Do reconnects reuse the conversation id or create new ones?

sam: Same conversation_id, new session_id. Example trace: conv=conv_221 old_sid=sid-A new_sid=sid-B server emitted terminal chunk then re-emitted tail on resumed socket.

ben: Sounds like a half-close ack race. Who closed the socket? edge or proxy?

sam: Proxy did idle close (FIN) during a GC pause on edge. Edge processed FIN but stream_state terminal write was delayed; proxy recycled socket and the client retried attach; upstream replayed tail because it hadn't durably marked terminal.

kavi: Telemetry shows tail_replay_count spiked together with ws_close_inflight. We mark terminal after durable write; GC pause delayed that durably acking. Proxy closed early.

maya: Console ops: a few enterprise tenants reported "duplicated messages" and saw quota drops. We need replay visibility in token breakdowns.

lina: Can you share a repro? Simulate paused write path while proxy closes.

sam: Repro (conceptual):
# open WS, trigger long model response
# simulate edge GC: sleep 200ms before persisting stream_state
# proxy idle timeout fires and rebinds socket
# client reconnects, server replays tail because stream_state wasn't committed

ben: Short-term mitigations: increase proxy idle timeout or make proxy wait for state ack. Long-term: durable terminal ack + resume idempotency or replay token.

kavi: Bumping proxy idle timeout to 1s removed replays in local tests, but costs more idle sockets. Alternative: add a "closing: pending" control frame proxies treat as sticky for 500ms. That needs proxy change but lower resource cost.

maya: Product: customers prefer no-duplication even if socket costs rise. Treat as P1 for billing accuracy on paid tiers.

lina: Ops, can we list affected tenants for customer comms?

ops-bot: @billing-bot running query for duplicates between 2026-03-21T03:15 and 2026-03-21T03:25

ben: Also add console metric ws_replay_tail_tokens so we can chart and correlate with proxy closes. Maya, can we overlay that on per-tenant charts?

maya: Yes. UX: red overlay labeled "replayed tokens" with hover for sample traces. I'll add to backlog.

kavi: Plan: push proxy idle_time bump to staging + edge best-effort flush of terminal marker with 300ms timeout; if flush fails set a replay_protection flag on resume for 10s. Also add previous_terminal_seq in resume logs to help post-billing dedupe.

sam: After proxy idle bump in staging, replay counts dropped ~97% in synthetic tests. Edge best-effort flush cut the rest.

ops-bot: @deploy-bot canary: proxy-idle-timeout-bump v1 -> 3/12 hosts

ben: Add alert: if ws_replay_tail_tokens > threshold AND ws_close_inflight_rate > 0.5 over 10m, page SRE. Also add billing audit job to subtract confirmed replayed tokens.

kavi: I'll write RFC for durable terminal ACK and idempotent resume token with cost tradeoffs.

maya: I'll prepare console changes and coordinate customer comms if needed.

lina: Thanks. Short-term: proxy idle bump + best-effort flush. Medium-term: durable terminal ack + resume idempotency + console replay metrics. Postmortem + customer comms after metrics stabilize.

sam: TL;DR: root cause = proxy idle close during edge write pause -> terminal not durable -> tail replay on reconnect -> duplicate tokens billed. Mitigations deployed to staging/canary.

ben: Add unit tests in streaming runtime for simulated GC pause + proxy close.
